an4.202:1.1: asappurisañca vo bhikkhavo desissāmi asappurisena asappurisatarañca,
an4.202:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco assaddho hoti, ahiriko hoti, anottappī hoti, appassuto hoti, kusīto hoti, muṭṭhassatī hoti, duppañño hoti.
an4.202:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā ca assaddho hoti, parañca assaddhiye samādapeti.
an4.202:3.3: attanā ca ahiriko hoti, parañca ahirikatāya samādapeti.
an4.202:3.4: attanā ca anottappī hoti, parañca anottappe samādapeti.
an4.202:3.5: attanā ca appassuto hoti, parañca appassute samādapeti.
an4.202:3.6: attanā ca kusīto hoti, parañca kosajje samādapeti.
an4.202:3.7: attanā ca muṭṭhassatī hoti, parañca muṭṭhasacce samādapeti.
an4.202:3.8: attanā ca duppañño hoti, parañca duppaññatāya samādapeti.
an4.202:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco saddho hoti, hirimā hoti, ottappī hoti, bahussuto hoti, āraddhaviriyo hoti, satimā hoti, paññavā hoti.
an4.202:5.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā ca saddhāsampanno hoti. parañca saddhāsampadāya samādapeti.
an4.202:5.3: attanā ca hirimā hoti, parañca hirimatāya samādapeti
an4.202:5.4: attanā ca ottappī hoti, parañca ottappe samādapeti.
an4.202:5.5: attanā ca bahussuto hoti. parañca bāhusacce samādapeti.
an4.202:5.6: attanā ca āraddhaviriyo hoti, parañca viriyārambhe samādapeti.
an4.202:5.7: attanā ca upaṭṭhitasatī hoti, parañca satipaṭṭhāne samādapeti.
an4.202:5.8: attanā ca paññāsampanno hoti, parañca paññāsampadāya samādapeti.
